title: Nvidia's money comes back to Nvidia
summary: Nvidia invests in OpenAI. OpenAI pays Oracle for computing. Oracle spends that on Nvidia chips.

steps.text: Nvidia puts $30B into OpenAI's 2026 funding round. Its earlier $100B plan never became a contract.
OpenAI agrees to pay Oracle about $300B over five years for cloud computing.
Oracle buys roughly $40B of Nvidia chips to build those data centers.

title: AMD pays its customers in its own stock
summary: AMD lets its two biggest new customers buy its shares cheaply, and they commit to huge chip orders.

steps.text: AMD gives OpenAI the right to buy up to 160 million AMD shares.
OpenAI commits to 6 gigawatts of AMD chips.
AMD gives Meta the same deal: up to 160 million shares.
Meta commits to up to 6 gigawatts of AMD chips, reportedly over $100B.

title: Anthropic's investors are also its landlords
summary: Each tech giant that invests in Anthropic gets much of that money back as cloud spending.

steps.text: Google pledges up to $40B.
Anthropic rents up to a million Google chips, worth tens of billions.
Amazon puts in $5B more, with up to $20B later.
Anthropic commits over $100B to Amazon's cloud over ten years.
Nvidia pledges up to $10B, and Microsoft up to $5B.
Anthropic commits $30B to Microsoft's cloud, running on Nvidia chips.

title: CoreWeave borrows to buy Nvidia chips, and Nvidia backs it
summary: Nvidia owns part of CoreWeave and promised to rent its spare capacity. CoreWeave borrows heavily to buy Nvidia chips.

steps.text: Nvidia invests another $2B in CoreWeave.
Nvidia agrees to buy up to $6.3B of computing CoreWeave can't sell.
Lenders have put about $51.6B into CoreWeave, including leases.
CoreWeave spends that money on Nvidia chips.
Customers like Meta and OpenAI sign contracts to rent that capacity back.

title: More of the buildout now runs on debt
summary: Cash from the companies' own profits no longer covers the spending, so they are borrowing.

steps.text: Meta sells $30B of bonds in 2025, then $25B more in 2026.
Blue Owl's venture with Meta finances its $27B Hyperion data center.
Oracle sells $25B of bonds.
Microsoft sells about $25B of bonds this week, its first US deal since 2017.
Banks lend SoftBank $40B...
...which helps SoftBank put $30B more into OpenAI.

title: Borrowed billions for Nvidia's newest chips
summary: Lenders finance SpaceX's chip lease. The chips come from Nvidia, which also invested in xAI.

steps.text: Nvidia invests in xAI's funding round. Reports put it at $2B to $10B.
An Apollo-led group lines up a roughly $40B lease for SpaceX this week.
That pays for about $40B of Nvidia's newest chips for xAI.
